name: Norton
source:
The Wizard of the North

Love Tendency: Gentlemanly and understanding, but would do anything for the sake of the Land of Oz.
Place: The country of the Gillikins
Motto: Concern is the key and door to the future

Norton is the good Wizard of the North, who rules over the country of the Gillikins. He was the first comrade you met during your journey when you were small. Calm and composed, he has always watched over the Land of Oz gently.
However, behind his smile lies a deep anguish unknown to anyone.
As the day of prophecy comes near, his distress grows deeper, until you finally break the cover of his smile.
Can you save him from the loneliness hidden behind his gentle smile...?

[Official in-game description]
